column6: Please note that all the definitions listed here should be "negated". Please read the following explanation by the Great Andhrabharati:  LB We know that the prefix 'vi' has two meanings.. intense (viśeṣa) and opposite (vyatireka). LB While Wilson (WIL) has "properly" applied the ’vi’ as indicating 'viśeṣa' in 'viśuddha' (= vi_śuddha), he made a mistake in taking it to indicate 'vyatireka' in 'aviśuddha' (= a_vi_śuddha) to arrive at the faulty meanings (with two negatives 'a' & 'vi' cancelling each other!). LB And this was blindly taken "as is" in YAT and SHS.
